en.basel-kadem: 85.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said:
We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Ali bin Hakam, from Kulaib bin Mu’awiya al-Asadi, that he said:

I said to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him: Your party  is saying: For the performer of pilgrimage, his family and property are in the assurance of Allah. However, it might me that he bequeaths with regards to his family, and it might be that I see that he goes out and his family is afflicted with afflictions. He, peace be upon him, said: He would bequeath with regards to them in that which he used to do.
As for what is present and he is not able to repel, then no.
